packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates for stable (>=1.0.0) packages once tests pass
Automerge all devDependencies updates once tests pass
Automerge GitHub Actions digest, patch and minor updates
Automerge Docker digest and patch updates.

Never automerge Docker minor bumps. In docker versioning a runtime feature-line change (e.g. python:3.14-slim -> 3.15-slim) is a 'minor', and the generic minor/patch rule above would otherwise automerge it — but the docker-build check only assembles the image while host CI pins the language version, so a runtime minor must be reviewed manually. This later rule resets automerge to false for Docker minors.

GHCR does not expose release timestamps, so under Renovate 42 the minimumReleaseAge check can never pass and internalChecksFilter=strict would stop these branches from ever being created (e.g. ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv). Exempt GHCR images from the age gate so they keep updating; they remain digest-pinned and CI-gated.
Require manual review for all major updates

Stay on TypeScript 6.x: the 7.x native-Go port has no stable programmatic API, so svelte-check / @sveltejs/kit (which embed the compiler) break under it. Revisit once the Svelte toolchain adopts the TS 7 API.

Run Renovate's lockfile updates on npm 11, the major CI (setup-node 26) and the image build use. npm 12 defaults allow-remote=none, which refuses the registry tarball of any package declaring bundleDependencies (npm/cli#9800) — Tailwind 4's @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi — so every package-lock.json update fails with EALLOWREMOTE. Lift once CI moves to npm 12 and the upstream fix has shipped.
